import sys, time
import serial
PORT = '/dev/cu.usbserial-1130'
FORBIDDEN = '/dev/cu.usbserial-10'
ser = serial.Serial(port=None, baudrate=115200, timeout=0.2, write_timeout=1)
ser.dtr = False
ser.rts = False
ser.port = PORT
ser.open()
try:
    time.sleep(1.0)
    ser.reset_input_buffer()
    ser.write(b'status\n')
    ser.write(b'sensors\n')
    ser.flush()
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 8.0
    lines = []
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        raw = ser.readline()
        if raw:
            line = raw.decode(errors='replace').strip()
            lines.append(line)
            print(line, flush=True)
    status = next((line for line in lines if line.startswith('status firmware_sha=')), None)
    sensors = any(line.startswith('sensors:') for line in lines)
    if status is None or 'outputs=' not in status or 'rf_ready=' not in status or not sensors:
        print(f'GROWBOX_RUNTIME_IDENTIFICATION_FAIL port={PORT} forbidden_port_untouched={FORBIDDEN} flash_started=0 rf_started=0')
        raise SystemExit(4)
    print(f'GROWBOX_RUNTIME_IDENTIFICATION_PASS port={PORT} forbidden_port_untouched={FORBIDDEN} flash_started=0 rf_started=0 status={status}')
finally:
    ser.close()
PY
